name: Spicy Sour Noodles (Inspired by Suan La Fen)

instructions.primary_message: For the Broth Base: In a heat-safe serving bowl, add sesame seeds, garlic, and scallions. In a small saucepan or skillet, heat neutral oil over medium-high heat until just smoking. Immediately pour hot oil over the aromatics in the bowl to bloom.
For the Noodles: To the bowl with the hot infused oil, add black vinegar, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, preserved mustard greens (if using), and chili oil; set aside.
Bring a medium pot of water to a boil (do not salt). Add noodles and cook until just tender with a slight bite, following package time guidance. Reserve 1/2 cup cooking water, then drain.
Add 1/2 cup hot cooking water to bowl with prepared oil and stir to combine. Add noodles and stir gently to incorporate. Season with salt to taste.
Top with roasted peanuts and serve immediately.

schema_metadata.keywords: Suan La Fen, Spicy Sour Noodles, 15-Minute Noodle Bowl Recipe

description: Inspired by suan la fen, these spicy sour noodles feature a tangy, chili oil–spiked broth made right in the serving bowl. Ready in just 20 minutes, they’re fast, comforting, and packed with bold flavor.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 1 tablespoon Sichuan preserved mustard greens (cui mi ya cai) (optional); 2 tablespoons roasted peanuts for serving

Optional substitutions: thin fresh Chinese wheat noodles → fresh thin egg pasta
author: Qi Ai
